id: title:gantoine:check the denominator of ratio metrics in anomaly investigations

review.posthog_relevance: Reduces false positives in AI-driven anomaly investigation prompts by adding instructions to distinguish genuine metric shifts from statistical noise caused by small denominators.
review.reason: Adds instructions to an AI prompt to warn against treating small-sample ratios as significant without checking the denominator and baseline counts, and suggests alternative recommendations. This targets the AI-driven anomaly investigation workflow.
review.uncertainty: The benefit relies on the AI following the prompt instructions; no runtime behavior or test results are shown. The score is conservative as this is a prompt improvement rather than a demonstrated system behavior or critical path change.
